ATC Vet — QM01AE07. Pharmacopoeias. In US. USP 31 (Suprofen). A white to off-white powder, odourless or having a slight odour. Sparingly soluble in water. Profile Suprofen is an NSAID (p.96). Suprofen has been used as 1% eye drops to inhibit the miosis that may occur during ocular surgery. It was formerly given orally in mild to moderate pain and in os- teoarthritis and rheumatoid arthritis but, after reports of adverse renal reactions, marketing of the oral dose form was suspended worldwide.
